candidates.name: Katyusha MRL
candidates.finding: Only zero can appear as an unsigned integer range MOD; nonzero modifiers require a + or - sign. The PDF's bare 3 is therefore invalid chart notation. Army and the N5.3 English/Spanish Wiki both show +3 in these bands, confirming an omitted plus sign rather than a gameplay discrepancy.
candidates.uncertainty: The reason the plus sign is missing from the PDF, and whether a formal erratum exists, has not been established. The intended +3 range MOD is not in doubt; preserve the raw PDF value.
